Britain’s Prince William and Princess Catherine are on a three-day visit to India. During their Mumbai visit, the royal couple played gully cricket with Sachin Tendulkar and took a ride on the Mumbai Metro. They will attend the sixth edition of the Earthshot Prize on November 17, being held in India for the first time.
